_readme: Company intelligence used by intel/companies.py. Matching normalizes the employer string (lowercase, strip punctuation and Inc/LLC/Ltd), then tries exact alias matches and finally whole-word alias search, longest alias first. Prefix an alias with '=' to allow only an exact whole-name match (use it for short or ambiguous names such as 'sig' or 'td'). Board entries in config.json may pin a company with "company_key". Add firms here, not in code. 'type' must be one of the keys in 'types'. Each type names its tracks (see tracks in taxonomy.json): finance, tech or both. A finance type's section is where Settings lists it under Finance; a type without finance is listed for its tracks' boards. Settings offers finance and both types under Finance and tech types under the tech boards; a recognized tech employer earns the recognized-employer company points only for a profile with a tech board.
